core_claim: On 29 country radio stations across 17 U.S. cities in 2022, women's songs were played back-to-back 0.5% of the time vs men's 65% — a gap that on 25 of 29 stations falls below pure chance, evidence the 'no two women in a row' rule from 2015's Tomato-gate scandal is now empirically observable in airplay logs.
title: Two Tomatoes Don't Touch
subtitle: How country radio's unwritten rule against playing women back-to-back shows up in 182,848 song plays from 2022.
